title: Arcade
description: Arcade is the inaugural event of Skill&Tell, featuring a full day packed with fun and challenging activities! Teams compete in various challenges, including math puzzles, programming tasks, the famous scavenger hunt, and other exciting games.

title: ElectroHub
description: Electro Hub is an exciting electronics day designed for beginners to dive into the world of Arduino. During this event, participants get hands-on experience learning how to use Arduino and its applications.

title: IndabaX
description: IndabaX is a series of community-driven AI and machine learning events across Africa, empowering local innovators to tackle regional challenges. It fosters collaboration, skill-building, and growth of AI talent within the continent.

title: AgriChallenge
description: Agri Challenge is Algeria’s premier hackathon where students and innovators develop AI-driven solutions to real agricultural problems. It fosters creativity, collaboration, and cutting-edge technology for a smarter agriculture future.
